text:
noah: Hi folks, i'm scheduled for oncall starting Monday. Two quick asks: who should i pair with for the first shadow, and what's the fastest way to validate my PD contacts + test alerts? also where's the ultra-short triage cheat sheet?

ivy: welcome noah :wave: i'm your week-1 buddy. Add me on PD (ivy@redwood.com). For a smoke test run this curl (VPN required):
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api.redwood.internal/v1/pager/test -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN\" -d '{\"user\":\"noah\",\"mode\":\"push\"}'
```
OpsBot will enqueue a test alert. If you see 403 check SSO role and ~/.redwood/credentials.

leo: added you to the oncall calendar and shadow slot. Short triage cheat sheet: 1) Confirm impact (who/what/how many users) 2) Check runbook -> key mitigations 3) If P1, page infra/db owner in 5m no ack 4) Post incident in #incidents. Link: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/oncall/cheatsheet (one-pager).

noah: ran the curl and got 403. SSO shows active session.

ivy: 403 usually missing PD role. Leo, can you grant the oncall-rotator role? Also check that noah's phone is set to push + SMS in PD.

leo: done 44d granted role and synced PD. noah try again.

opsbot: OpsBot: Pager test queued for noah. Delivering in ~20s.

noah: got the push. PD app shows source: ops-sim. Thanks. Also, any preferred message format for the initial incident summary?

ivy: TL;DR summary in slack: "P1 - brief cause - impact - mitigation in progress - next steps". Keep it <3 lines. Example: "P1 - DB write errors - 40% of requests failing - failed-over to replica, investigating schema migration - will update in 10m."

opsbot: OpsBot: Test log 1825000001 - delivered to noah via push; status: delivered; ack: none.

noah: perfect. i'll join the shadow shift and review the cheat sheet. Appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:
